outcome_detail.diagnosis_hint: git_diff_lines=0 across ALL iterations — agent had NO visibility into what changed. The error is a missing 'settings' module but generate_checks didn't create a check for 'verify settings module exists' because it couldn't see the diff. The agent edited config.rs but context_snapshot showed 0 diff lines, meaning the agent's edits weren't captured. ISSUE: context_snapshot MUST include git diff (or uncommitted changes) before generate_checks. Without seeing what changed, checks can't cover the right files. Also: checks_quality=poor because generate_checks had no diff to reason about.
